name: Dania Academy
about: Dania Academy is a business academy (erhvervsakademi) in Jutland. Its one English-taught first degree is new: a professional bachelor in Cyber Security in Viborg, 195 ECTS over three and a quarter years with a six-month internship. The first intake is September 2027.
ibNotes: No page read for this institution mentions DP Course Results. The canonical Opportunities apply the national rule (ev-ufsn-ib-course-results): Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 in all six subjects and three at HL, give access to AP and professional bachelor programmes.

deadlines.label: Application (IB and all international qualifications)
deadlines.notes: Through optagelse.dk, which opens on 1 February.

sources.title: Cyber Security at Dania Academy (Viborg) is a new English-taught bachelor of 195 ECTS over 3¼ years, starting in September 2027. It needs English B and Mathematics B, and charges no tuition to EU/EEA students.
The title awarded is Professionsbachelor i Cybersikkerhed, 195 ECTS over 3¼ years. Students may leave after two years or continue to the professionsbachelor.

notes: Research notes kept for the record. The site renders the canonical records in data/institutions, data/programmes and data/opportunities, whose evidence is in data/evidence/dk-colleges.json.
The Danish page says students on Cyber Security can finish after two years or continue to the full professionsbachelor. Either way, you apply to the professionsbachelor programme.
The English page repeats a sentence that lets English C plus a test meet the language requirement, but the specific entry requirement is still English B.

programmes.name: Cyber Security
programmes.summary: A new professional bachelor in protecting organisations against cyber attacks: network security, encryption, secure software, and security governance and compliance. It includes a six-month internship. It is 195 ECTS over three and a quarter years in Viborg, starting September 2027. Needs English B and Maths B.
programmes.requirementsText: Specific entry requirements: English at the Danish B-level. This means that international applicants must have had English for at least 210 hours (60 minutes each) during the last three years of their upper-secondary education. And Mathematics at the Danish B-level. This means that international applicants must have had mathematics for at least 250 hours (60 minutes each) during the last three years of their upper-secondary education.
